caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden object, vertically oriented, with an ornate metallic cross on top. The main body is colored in shades of brown, representing wooden planks with visible grains and slight irregularities. Mounted on the upper front area of the wood is a square metallic plate, pierced with small holes. Adjacent to the upper left side of the plate, there is a small rectangular label. The top edge of the structure is adorned with a decorative trim, colored in a slightly darker brown, with a scallop-shaped outline and spiraled elements at the corners. To the right of the front view, there is a side elevation drawn in thin black lines, which includes a measurement indicating the height as 5 feet 10 inches. At the bottom, a top-down cross-sectional view indicates the width as 2 feet 1 inch. The drawing is signed "Geoffrey Holt" in the lower right corner. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Side of Original Confessional
